content: Backrest (restic web frontend, official getting-started): backup plans configure paths as a text list ('Directories/files to backup') and excludes as glob patterns ('Patterns or paths to skip', example *node_modules*). No folder tree for selection; UI strengths are snapshot browsing/restore, cron schedules, retention, hooks, notifications. Takeaway: even the most popular restic frontend has no tree selection - a genuine gap BombVault can fill.
